root_cause: Customer-facing AI output could be source-bound internally while the portal did not consistently expose provenance, freshness, uncertainty and verification state to the customer. That leaves trust dependent on presentation rather than inspectable evidence.
prevention_rule: Every material customer-facing AI analysis, summary, recommendation, chat answer and autonomous action must inherit the Trusted Advisor assurance contract: distinguish facts from derivations and hypotheses, expose provenance/freshness/evidence gaps, never invent confidence percentages, fail closed on missing evidence, require provider/runtime readback for executed actions, and feed verified outcomes and customer corrections back into future advice.

outcome.truth_boundary: This learning records the required trust contract and implementation lineage. LIVE & BEWEZEN is only valid after protected merge and production readback.
